title: Canonical T−24 Time and Availability Contract
mission: Implement the single operational cutoff function, timestamp normalization policy, availability-proof grades, sealed-period controls, and eligibility predicate used by every subsequent task.
steps: Store canonical UTC timestamptz and derive HKT explicitly.
Implement availability grades A–E and an eligibility function that requires available_at <= cutoff.
Create sealed-period metadata and development/live roles.
Implement a conservative target-label availability contract; forbid casual T−1 daily Tmax use.
Add database constraints/views and application helpers.
Document conflict resolution if an existing cutoff differs.
acceptance: One canonical cutoff version used everywhere
Live role cannot read labels/residuals/sealed outcomes
Rows without proof cannot appear in strict views
failure: Existing incompatible contract: preserve it, document, and require owner decision; never silently switch
